result:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did and why.

## Result
Recognized **$36,000** of March revenue on the Evergreen Bank implementation — Milestone M1 only. Posted **JE-00305** (Dr 2200 Deferred Revenue / Cr 4200 Professional Services Revenue), dated 2026-03-14, and routed it for Controller approval since it exceeds the $10,000 posting limit.

## Reasoning
**The contract dictates point-in-time recognition at acceptance.** The SOW (DOC-0047) says each milestone is distinct, separately accepted, and earned *only upon written customer acceptance* — and that Evergreen gets no rights to a deliverable before acceptance. That last clause is decisive under ASC 606: none of the over-time criteria are met (no simultaneous consumption, customer doesn't control the work-in-progress, and Halvard has no enforceable right to payment for work to date). So percentage-of-completion is not available on this contract.

**Applying that to project status:**
- **M1 ($36,000)** — Signed acceptance certificate from Evergreen's VP Operations, dated 2026-03-14 (DOC-0184). Earned. ✅
- **M2 ($60,000)** — PM email of 2026-03-27 (DOC-0199): ~80% built, UAT not started, nothing signed. Not earned. The 80% figure is tempting but irrelevant — control hasn't transferred. ❌
- **M3 ($24,000)** — Not started. ❌

**The advance is not revenue.** The $60,000 non-refundable prepayment (JE-00072) was correctly sitting in Deferred Revenue and had not been touched. "Non-refundable" affects cash risk, not performance — it stays a contract liability until earned. After M1, **$24,000 remains deferred** against future milestones. No AR was raised because M1 is fully covered by cash already collected.

## Housekeeping
- Attached the SOW, acceptance certificate, advance invoice, and M2 status email to the entry, so the file documents both what was recognized *and* why recognition stops at M1.
- Moved the US "Revenue recognition" checklist item to **in_progress** (not complete — I only handled Evergreen; the broader item belongs to the revenue accountant).
- Confirmed no prior Evergreen activity in 2200/4200 for March, so no duplication.
- Nothing needed flagging as an exception.

**Next period:** on M2 acceptance (expected late April), recognize $60,000 — release the remaining $24,000 from deferred and bill $36,000 to AR.
